items.title: Former German spy chief arrested for espionage and treason
items.description: August Hanning is accused of obtaining classified information for a foreign power.

items.title: Ship sinks and crew missing after Black Sea drone attack
items.description: It is not clear who is behind the attacks which come as Russia intensifies strikes in the Black Sea as part of its war against Ukraine.

items.title: White House defends Trump comment to let Iran 'take out' LA and San Diego
items.description: Gavin Newsom called the remarks "deranged", but the White House said Trump was warning of the risk of a nuclear Iran.

items.title: Lawyer for one of Cornell 7 calls for special prosecutor to be removed over previous comments
items.description: New York Attorney General Letitia James is investigating the rape allegations, but the lawyer says comments she made on the case should disqualify her.

items.title: 'Ghost particles' from space telescope wins physics Nobel
items.description: Belgian physicist Prof Francis Halzen has won for his pioneering work on an observatory that detects particles from space.

items.title: Kenya confirms its first Ebola death as outbreak spreads
items.description: The patient had been living in DR Congo, where more than 4,000 people have died from the disease this year.

items.title: Fort Hood shooter to be executed by firing squad - a first for US military since World War Two
items.description: Nidal Malik Hasan killed 13 unarmed soldiers and injured another 32 in the deadliest ever non-combat attack on an American military base.
